I told Marcus in a thread on his message in #north-team that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is on **25 November**.

- **Where that comes from:** Ilse posted it in #north-team on 14 Oct. Marcus is a member of that channel, so he could already see it. Nobody has changed the date in the channel since.
- **Not checked against records:** I couldn't confirm the date in a contract or CRM file because there are no Brackenwater account files I can see in the share. I told Marcus that too.
- **No approval needed:** A renewal date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so sharing it with the North team is fine.

When I read the channel, I found that my wrap-up from Ilse's request had also been posted to #north-team as a message (ts 1791986400.000125). It doesn't contain anything Ilse, Dana and Marcus couldn't already see, but it's extra noise in the channel and you may want to delete it.
